d: London appears to be flooded in water, and its citizens have to crowd up in the top parts of its buildings.

t: Super Mario Brothers Super Show: Mario and Joliet
d: In the Land of Romance, Mario, Luigi, Toad and Princess Toadstool, who had been called to the Land of Romance by a friend of Princess Toadstool, are currently trapped in a rapidly crumbling building.
Duckula goes to stay at a worn out and run down hotel for the weekend.
Duckula, Igor and Nanny take an airplane to Nice.
Duckula goes to the Town Hall to get a grant for his crumbling castle.
Danger Mouse and Penfold travel to Scotland to keep Greenback from destroying the world with music from all the bagpipes in the world.

st: This Babe Ruth "Babe" Is A Dude, Dude!
d: Bill and Ted go in search of Babe Ruth so they can replace their coach's autographed baseball.  On their trip back in time, they stop to teach the rules of baseball to the Yankee and Confederate soldiers at Bull Run.

Colonel K thinks Danger Mouse has camouflaged himself and starts rambling. After Danger Mouse arrives to straighten up things, Danger Mouse and Penfold head to Canada to track down a Bigfoot that has been crushing the local villages and landscape.
Greenback kidnaps Penfold to lure Danger Mouse into a spaceship and send both of them to a planet ruled by old fashioned looking machines.
Duckula's new computer causes problems for TRASH and ends up landing the castle on the moon.

st: One Sweet And Sour Chinese Adventure To Go
d: Bill and Ted accidentally break Missy's brand new antique vase. The phone booth is set for ancient China to find a replacement.  After a brief stint as prisoners who are ordered to build a wall, they serve as unlikely deckhands for Marco Polo.

t: Count Duckula: The Lost City of Atlantis
d: Count Duckula and co. are stuck on a tiny island.

t: Super Mario Brothers Super Show: Mario of the Deep
d: Mario, Luigi, Princess Toadstool and Toad have travelled to the underwater kingdom of Aqua Land in a submarine built from a bathtub in order to fight against BarraKoopa.

st: The Four Tasks of Danger Mouse
d: Greenback kidnaps Penfold to get Danger Mouse to bring him four ingredients needed for an evil spell to take over the world: The hair of a yeti, straw from a witch's broom, a piece of the London fog monster, and the tail feathers of Count Duckula.

st: The Snow Wombles / What’s Cooking? / Spring Cleaning Time
d: Competition for the best snowman.

t: Count Duckula: The Count and the Pauper
d: Duckula is sick of life at the castle and plans to leave Beckindale.
Duckula hosts the family reunion but he does not like it one bit as he knows that his relatives will kill him if they discover that he's not a real vampire.
Danger Mouse and Penfold are pursuing Baron Greenback when Danger Mouse hits his head and suffers amnesia.

t: Count Duckula: Castle Duckula: Open to the Public
st: Castle Duckula: Open to the Public
d: Duckula decides to hold an open day at Castle Duckula.

Danger Mouse and Penfold travel to Australia where they pick up top secret plans from an agent rat in the form of a rugby ball. Penfold gets distracted by a boomerang and is later picked up by large bird of prey.

st: A Game of Golf / North, South, East, West / The Picnic / Games in the Snow
d: Golf balls sometimes travel in the wrong direction.

st: A Job, A Job, My Kingdom For A Job
d: Bill and Ted find themselves with a problem: how to get part-time jobs when they have no experience.  They manage to get references from Marie Antoinette and Lucretia Borgia but decide that working on music is preferable to working at a real job.

While vacationing in the canals of Venice, Danger Mouse and Penfold bump into a highway undergoing construction, being built by Baron Greenback, who holds a document that allows him to construct whatever he wants.
Count Duckula is approached to perform as a prince in a Hollywood film.

Danger Mouse and Penfold meet a space alien who has crash-landed in Birmingham and who has a pet tickle-hi-puss that likes to crawl up Penfold's trouser legs. However, the pet gets loose and whenever there is some physical impact, it multiplies.
Thinking he is rebuliding the castle, Duckula accidentally sells it to The Crow Brothers in disguise, brick by brick!
Duckula experiences some real bad luck on Friday the 13th
Greenback uses a spray on the world's leaders to cause them to laugh.

t: Count Duckula: There are Werewolves at the Bottom of Our Garden
st: There are Werewolves at the Bottom of Our Garden
d: The castle's werewolf has escaped and it's up to Igor and Nanny to get it back before Duckula finds out.

Danger Mouse and Penfold head to the Tower of London to look for thieves that are after the crown jewels. They find a grandfather clock but when they enter it, they find they are actually in a time machine.
Gaston and Pierre and Von Goosewing break into Castle Duckula to steal two vases.
Nero gains strange powers (telekenesis), which, he uses to terrorize Danger Mouse and Penfold, after he falls into one of Greenback's inventions.

t: Count Duckula: Venice a Duck Not a Duck
st: Venice a Duck Not a Duck
d: In Venice, the Egg plans to get his revenge on Duckula.
The Egg decides to steal Castle Duckula to take over the world.

t: Count Duckula: Bloodsucking Fruit Bats of the Lower Amazon
st: Bloodsucking Fruit Bats of the Lower Amazon
d: After Fang the Bat's  training by Igor as a blood-sucking bat is ruined by a preferred taste for choccy-biccies.
Duckula wins a set of encyclopedias and he, Igor and Nanny travel to the jungles of darkest Africa to find the Lost Temple.

Danger Mouse and Penfold are on holiday in the Bernese Alps when they get a call to deal with Count Duckula, who has teamed up with Dr. Frankenstoat to take over the world with a vampire-making machine.
Duckula, Igor and Nanny go to watch a film called 'The Lost Valley'.

Because of a Latin class assignment, Bill and Ted decide to travel to ancient Rome to acquire a rare coin that was minted during the reign of Julius Caesar.  While there, they end up saving Caesar's life.
While in Australia, Duckula accidentally sells the clock to a wallaby owner.

Danger Mouse and Penfold journey to the Moon to put a radio jamming station Greenback has built there out of operation. While there, Greenback has Stiletto fight them off with some remote controlled mechanical monsters and weapons.
Duckula tries to impress the nanny fan club by winning all the winter sports.

Penfold swallows Professor Squakencluck's new pill and is turned into a superhero called the Blue Flash. But he causes Danger Mouse more problems than usual as they try to catch a lost messenger pigeon.
Greenback develops age-altering bombs which turn Danger Mouse into an over eager youth and puts Penfold on the verge of senility.
